card.name: Section headings and cross-references in labels
card.fires_on: Words at the edge of numbered section headings or cross-references in drug labels, such as 'Test' in 'Drug/Laboratory Test Interactions' and 'utions' in 'Warnings and Precautions'. Also fires on a gap or heading right before a new numbered section.

modes.label: Heading words
modes.description: A word inside or starting a numbered label heading, like Addition or Test.
modes.example: 7.2 Drug/Laboratory<< Test>> Interactions Blood Tests Naproxen may

modes.label: Warnings and Precautions reference
modes.description: The end of Precautions inside a bracketed see-section cross-reference.
modes.example: is not recommended [see Warnings and Preca<<utions>> (5.10) ] .

modes.label: Break before next section
modes.description: A blank gap or closing parenthesis just before the next numbered section starts.

card.writes: It nudges output toward words meaning existing, added or included, in Chinese and English, with no clear link to the label text.
card.plain: It marks spots in a drug label where a section heading or a cross-reference to another section is being written.
